blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Weight-space post-training quantization (PTQ) must choose finite formats, granularities, quantizer families, transformations, and bits before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift.
Existing PTQ methods predict important pieces of this degradation, including reconstruction error, Hessian sensitivity, transformation effects, and downstream loss, but these pieces are usually scored after fixing the quantization geometry or inside separate configuration families.
We formulate weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection using priced layer-output error.
Each admissible layer configuration is treated as an error generator with a deployment cost, which induces a layer-output error covariance 𝚺 l ​ ( α l ) \bm{\Sigma}_{l}(\alpha_{l}) , and the full-precision model prices that covariance by downstream curvature, ρ ^ l ​ ( α l ) = 1 2 ​ Tr ⁡ ( 𝐇 ^ l ​ 𝚺 ^ l ​ ( α l ) ) \hat{\rho}_{l}(\alpha_{l})=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}(\hat{\mathbf{H}}_{l}\hat{\bm{\Sigma}}_{l}(\alpha_{l})) .
The price follows from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, whose first-order term cancels at the reference model.
It turns reconstruction and diagonal scores into reduced proxies that drop price factors, while finite formats, codebooks, granularities, and equivalent transformations become comparable candidates through the covariances they induce and the costs they pay.
A trace reduction then yields a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Weight-space PTQ is chosen before its final consequence is visible.
A deployment stack must decide, layer by layer, which finite format, granularity, quantizer family, pre-quantization transformation, and bitwidth to use, while the completed weight-quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift only after all of these choices have been composed.
Exhaustively building every candidate model is usually impossible, yet reducing the decision to mixed precision after fixing the geometry misses a central degree of freedom because the configuration itself determines what layer-output error will be injected.
The practical question is therefore not only how many bits to allocate, but how to rank admissible weight-space PTQ configurations before deployment trials.
The same calibration pass must score choices that have not yet been deployed.
blocks.zh:
重量空间PTQ在最终结果可见之前被选择.
部署堆栈必须逐层决定,其中限定格式、颗粒度、量子家族、量子化前转换以及比特width必须使用,而完成的量子化模型只有在所有这些选择组成之后才会显示其输出-分布漂移。
精细地构建每个候选模型通常是不可能的,然而在修整几何之后将决定降低到混合精度,错过了中央自由度,因为配置本身决定了将注入何种层输出错误.
因此,实际问题不仅在于要分配多少位,而且在部署试验前如何对可接受重量空间PTQ配置进行排序.
同样的校准证必须给尚未部署的选择打分。

blocks.en:
Prior work already shows why this question cannot be answered by one local proxy alone.
Reconstruction and second-order PTQ methods such as OBQ, OBC, GPTQ, AdaRound, BRECQ, QuIP, and QuIP# reduce or compensate local weight error [ 30 , 20 , 10 , 11 , 3 , 38 ] .
HAWQ-style methods, HIGGS, and Q-Palette use Hessian, sensitivity, linear-response, or rate-distortion signals for precision or level allocation [ 8 , 7 , 29 , 17 ] .
SmoothQuant, AWQ, QuaRot, SpinQuant, OmniQuant, AffineQuant, and FlatQuant show that scaling, rotations, incoherence, outlier handling, and learned transforms change quantization behavior [ 43 , 21 , 1 , 26 , 33 , 28 , 37 ] .
GuidedQuant and YAQA bring downstream loss or output-distribution information into quantization objectives [ 15 , 40 ] .
These results predict important pieces of PTQ degradation.
The missing object is a common pre-deployment price that compares bits, granularities, codebooks, transformations, and hardware costs as configurations of the same decision.

以前的工作已经表明,为什么这个问题不能由当地一个代理人单独回答。
重建及二阶PTQ方法,如OBQ,OBC,GPTQ,AdaRound,BRECQ,QuIP,以及QuIP#减少或补偿当地重量误差[30,20,10,11,3,38].
HAWQ型方法,HIGGS,和Q-Palette使用黑森,灵敏,线性反应,或速率扭曲信号进行精度或水平分配[8,7,29,17].
平滑泉,AWQ,QuaRot,SpinQuant,OmniQuant,AffineQuant,和FlatQuant显示,缩放,旋转,不连贯,外置处理,以及学习的变换变换变质行为[43,21,1,26,33,28,37].
GuidedQuant和YAQA将下游损失或输出分配信息引入量化目标[15,40].
这些结果预测了PTQ降解的重要部分.
缺失对象是一种常见的部署前价格,它比较比特,颗粒,密码本,变换,以及硬件成本作为同一决定的配置.

blocks.en:
This paper makes that price the organizing object.
A layer configuration is an admissible weight-space PTQ choice supplied by the deployment stack, and it may change the candidate coordinate, choose a finite-format replacement, and carry a backend cost. Sec. 2 turns this into a constrained selection problem over configurations under a deployment budget, with the full-precision-to-quantized forward KL as the target drift.
That ideal drift is not available before building the completed quantized model, so the selection problem forces a calibration-time substitute, namely the layer-output error covariance induced by a candidate and priced by the downstream curvature of the full-precision reference.
This covariance, together with cost, is the interface between broad PTQ mechanisms and the selector.
blocks.zh:
这份论文将组织对象定价。
层配置是由部署堆栈提供的可允许的重量空间PTQ选择,它可能会改变候选坐标,选择一个限定格式的替换,并带有后端成本. 第2条将这一点变成部署预算下配置的有限选择问题,目标漂移时完全精确到量化的KL。
这种理想的漂移在构建完成的量化模型之前并不存在,因此选择问题迫使一个校准时间的替代物,即由候选人诱导的、由全精度参考物的下游曲率定价的层输出误差。
这种共性,连同成本,是广义的PTQ机制与选择器之间的接口.

blocks.en:
Sec. 3 derives this substitute from the forward KL rather than postulating another reconstruction score.
At the full-precision reference, score cancellation removes the linear term, so the first retained local contribution is a quadratic price of candidate-induced layer-output error.
The candidate supplies the covariance of that error, while the reference model supplies the output-side curvature that makes some error directions more costly than others.
This immediately explains the role of familiar proxies because reconstruction drops the output curvature, and diagonal input scores also drop cross-channel input covariance.
Such proxies can be useful reduced scores, but they preserve configuration rankings only when the factors they drop are effectively constant over the candidates being compared.
The price therefore remains a configuration criterion rather than a reconstruction metric.
blocks.zh:
第3节来自前方的KL而不是假设另一个重建得分。
在全精度参考中,分数取消去掉线性术语,所以第一个保留的地方贡献是候选人引起的层输出错误的四价.
候选人提供该错误的共性,而参考模型提供输出侧曲率,使得一些错误方向比其他错误方向成本更高.
这立即解释了熟悉代词的作用,因为重建降低了输出曲率,对角输入分数也降低了跨通道输入共变.
这种代词可以有用地降低分数,但只有在其下降的因素与被比较的候选人相比实际上保持不变时,它们才会保持配置排名.
因此,价格仍然是一个配置标准,而不是一个重建指标。

blocks.en:
The same price also explains how PTQ configuration families enter the selector.
Finite formats, bits, granularities, vector codebooks, and palettes change the weight-perturbation moment being priced.
Equivalent transformations change the coordinate in which that perturbation is generated and the input covariance it acts on, while leaving the reference-side output metric fixed.
Under the isotropic trace reduction used for large models, each candidate can be scored by two candidate-side scalars and a cached curvature trace, then selected by a budgeted search over admissible costs.
Fixed-geometry bit allocation is therefore recovered only after the transformation, quantizer family, and granularity have been held fixed.
Before that point, PTQ is a broader configuration-selection problem over deployable choices, not an abstract continuous bit variable.
blocks.zh:
同样的价格也解释了PTQ配置家族是如何进入选择器的.
有限格式,比特,颗粒,矢量编码本,调色板改变正在定价的重量-扰动瞬间.
等效转换改变产生扰动的坐标及其作用的输入共性,同时使参考侧输出度量固定。
在大型型号使用的异热带微量减量下,每个考生可以通过两个候选侧斜尺和一个缓存曲率微量计分,然后通过预算搜索而不是允许成本来选择.
因此,固定的几何比特分配只有在变形后才能恢复,四聚体家族,颗粒性被固定.
在此之前,PTQ是一个比可部署选择更广泛的配置选择问题,而不是抽象的连续位变量.

blocks.en: The contribution centers on a price-prediction criterion for the configuration decision, using forward-KL and curvature signals to compare admissible PTQ choices across existing quantizer families. First , the paper identifies the object selected by weight-space PTQ as an admissible layer configuration that induces a layer-output error covariance and has a deployment cost. Second , it shows that full-precision-to-quantized forward KL assigns this covariance a quadratic quantization price, making reconstruction and diagonal scores interpretable as reduced prices. Third , it connects common PTQ families to the same price factors by showing that finite formats change perturbation moments, transformations change the candidate coordinate and input metric, and costs constrain deployability. Fourth , it turns these prices into a budgeted pre-deployment search rule that optimizes predicted quantization price directly, with mechanism evidence and scope boundaries organized around the same prediction chain.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.en:
The price-guided selector in Alg. 1 is useful only if its calibration-time scores preserve the target decision before the quantized model is built.
The experiments therefore test the prediction chain in the same order as the method.
First, controlled perturbation studies ask whether the realized price in ( 8 ) and the implemented trace price in ( 18 ) track the full-precision-to-quantized KL drift ( Sec. 4.1 ).
Second, end-to-end weight-only PTQ experiments ask whether optimizing the predicted price reduces configuration-search cost while preserving perplexity and downstream task accuracy ( Sec. 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Realized Price and Implemented-Trace-Price Align with KL Drift
blocks.zh: 4.1 已实现价格和已执行的跟踪价格与KL漂流

blocks.en:
The first empirical link is the one that can invalidate the selector.
If the realized layer-output price ( 8 ) and the implemented trace price ( 18 ) fail to track the final KL drift, then the price is not a valid surrogate for the target in ( 2 ).
For each controlled candidate, we build the corresponding quantized perturbation, evaluate the full-precision-to-quantized KL drift on held-out calibration inputs, and compare it with the realized price and the implemented trace price.
We evaluate this comparison on OPT-125M [ 51 ] and Qwen3-0.6B [ 45 ] , across transformation, bitwidths, and granularity candidates.
In particular, the transformation includes three types of whitening transformations (see Sec. B.5 ) and the no-transformation baseline.
We provide the detailed experimental setup in Appx. D .

blocks.en: 4.2 Price-Guided Configuration Selection
blocks.zh: 4.2 价格指导配置选择

blocks.en:
After the KL comparisons establish that price is a meaningful ranking signal, the remaining question is whether that signal improves the discrete PTQ decision made before deployment.
We evaluate this decision on Llama-3.2-1B across three representative configuration classes, including bit allocation, transformation selection, and granularity allocation (refer to Appx. D for details).

我们对Llama-3.2-1B的这一决定进行评价,分为三个代表性配置类别,包括位分配,变换选择和颗粒性分配(详见Appx. D).

blocks.en: 5 Related Work and Scope
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作和范围

blocks.en:
The closest bit-allocation neighbors differ mainly in what has already been fixed before allocation begins.
HAWQ, HAWQ-V2, and HAWQ-V3 use Hessian-aware signals for mixed precision [ 8 , 7 , 46 ] .
HIGGS-style methods relate layerwise reconstruction error to perplexity increase and allocate nonuniform quantization levels [ 29 ] .
Q-Palette takes a rate-distortion view of fractional-bit quantizers after Gaussianizing assumptions [ 17 ] .
These works are important fixed-geometry allocation references.
The present paper makes the geometry itself part of the pre-deployment configuration set and prices transformations, granularities, quantizer families, and bits with the same downstream metric.
blocks.zh:
最接近的位分配邻居主要在分配开始前已经固定的内容上有所不同.
HAWQ,HAWQ-V2和HAWQ-V3使用黑森-意识信号进行混合精度[8,7,46].
HIGGS风格的方法将层层重建错误与复杂度增高联系起来,并分配非单数化水平[29].
Q-Palette在高斯化假设后,对分数位的量子进行速率扭曲视图[17].
这些作品是重要的固定几何分配参考.
本文件使几何本身成为部署前配置集和价格变化,颗粒性,四聚体家族,以及具有相同下游度量的位点的一部分.

blocks.en:
Transformation and outlier methods occupy the other side of the same decision.
SmoothQuant, AWQ, OmniQuant, AffineQuant, FlatQuant, QuaRot, SpinQuant, QuIP, and QuIP# show how scaling, rotations, learned affine transforms, incoherence, and outlier handling change quantization behavior [ 43 , 21 , 33 , 28 , 37 , 1 , 26 , 3 , 38 ] .
In this formulation, these transformations become comparable before deployment through the priced layer-output error they induce.
End-loss methods such as GuidedQuant and YAQA are closest in metric because they use downstream loss or output-distribution information [ 15 , 40 ] .
This places the paper at the configuration-allocation level over admissible weight-space choices, with adaptive rounding objectives serving as close metric-aware neighbors.
blocks.zh:
变换和变异方法占据同一决定的另一面。
平滑泉,AWQ,OmniQuant,AffineQuant,Flatquant,Quarot,Spinquant,QuIP,和QuIP# 显示如何缩放,旋转,学习亲缘变换,不一致,以及外部处理变化量化行为[43,21,33,28,37,1,26,3,38].
在这种配制中,这些转换在通过它们引发的价层输出误差进行部署之前就具有可比性。
最终损失方法,如GuidedQuant和YAQA,最接近于公尺,因为它们使用下游损失或输出分配信息[15,40].
这使得论文处于配置-分配级别,而不是允许的权重-空间选择,适应性的四舍五入目标充当了近距离了解的邻居。

blocks.en:
The primary selector is deliberately scoped to weight-space PTQ.
Activation quantization, KV-cache quantization, runtime dynamic clipping, and QAT-style learned quantizers are inside the same price language only when their effect is exposed as a pre-deployment output-error covariance and a deployment cost.
The weight-activation extension, the AM-GM balance law inside the whitened isotropic surrogate, and the continuous allocation law are recorded formally in Sec. B.10 as branch consequences, not as the main selector’s objective.
The local quadratic price is intended for regimes where low-bit nonlocality, moment-model mismatch, cross-layer coupling, and curvature-proxy error remain secondary to the predicted price gap.
Because the selector optimizes the price-only objective ρ ^ ​ ( α ) \hat{\rho}(\alpha) , these effects define operating regimes for the predictor rather than extra optimization terms.
blocks.zh:
主选择器被刻意限定为重量空间PTQ.
激活量子化,KV-cache量子化,运行时动态剪辑,QAT风格的学习量子只有在其效果暴露为部署前输出-error共变和部署成本时,才会在同一个价格语言内.
权重激活扩展、AM-GM平衡法在白异构代孕内,持续分配法在Sec.B.10中被正式记录为分支后果,而不是主要选择者的目标。
本地四价是针对低位非局部性,瞬间模型不匹配,跨层耦合,曲率-代氧误差仍然与预测价格差距相次于的制度.
由于选择器优化了只限价的目标 ^ (α)\hat\rho}(\alpha),这些效果定义了预测器的操作系统而不是额外的优化术语.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
This paper formulates weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection.
Before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift, each admissible layer choice must be ranked by the layer-output error it will induce and the deployment cost it will pay.
Starting from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, the price theorem shows that score cancellation leaves a quadratic quantization price, so the reference model supplies the downstream curvature and each candidate supplies its error covariance.
This turns finite formats, granularities, codebooks, equivalent transformations, and fixed-geometry bit allocation into comparable instances of the same price-guided search, with the trace reduction providing a practical calibration-time score.
The resulting selector is most credible in the local, moment-stable, curvature-aligned regime tested by the evidence, and the same scope conditions identify where extending the price language beyond weight-space PTQ requires additional modeling.
blocks.zh:
本文将重量空间PTQ设定为部署前配置选择.
在完成的量化模型显示其输出-分配漂移之前,每一可允许的层选择必须按其将引发的层输出错误和其部署成本排序。
从全精度到量子化的远期KL开始,价格定理显示分数取消会留下四重量化价格,因此参考模型提供下游曲面,每个候选者提供其误差共变.
这使得限定格式、颗粒、编码本、等效变换和固定几何比特分配成为相同的价格指导搜索的可比实例,微量还原提供了实用的校准时间分数。
由此产生的选择器在经过证据测试的局部,瞬间稳定,曲率对齐的制度中最可信,同样的范围条件也明确了将价格语言扩展至重空PTQ需要额外建模之处.

blocks.en:
OBQ, GPTQ, and OBC-style methods use local second-order structure to compensate or order weight quantization decisions [ 10 , 11 ] .
QuIP and QuIP# combine incoherence processing with quantization guarantees and codebook structure [ 3 , 38 ] .
End-loss and model-preservation neighbors are the most direct novelty boundary because GuidedQuant uses end-loss guidance for quantization, while YAQA directly targets output-distribution preservation through end-to-end Hessian approximations and Kronecker sketches [ 15 , 40 ] .
Analytical neighbors such as provable OPTQ, QERA, ASER, RUQuant, and activation-sensitivity analysis study local PTQ ingredients or reconstruction refinements [ 48 , 47 , 54 , 24 , 44 ] .
The present paper uses these ingredients at a different decision level by predicting the price induced by candidate weight-space PTQ configurations and directly optimizing that price under deployment constraints.

SpQR, SqueezeLLM, AQLM, GPTVQ, VPTQ, and QTIP expand the admissible weight perturbation set through sparse exceptions, dense-sparse decompositions, additive codebooks, vector quantization, or trellis-coded quantization [ 6 , 16 , 9 , 41 , 25 , 39 ] .

blocks.en:
HAWQ, HAWQ-V2, and HAWQ-V3 use Hessian-aware signals for mixed-precision decisions [ 8 , 7 , 46 ] .
SliM-LLM, Q-Palette, Linearity-Theorem-style allocation, PTQ1.61, QQQ, LRQ, Atom, KIVI, KVQuant, and QServe enlarge the deployment space through salience, fractional-bit formats, low-bit limits, vector or system-aware constraints, KV-cache compression, and serving co-design [ 13 , 17 , 29 , 53 , 52 , 18 , 55 , 27 , 12 , 23 ] .
These methods sit downstream of the price because once candidate weight formats have predicted prices and deployment costs, hardware-aware deployment remains a discrete constrained selection problem.
The manuscript’s allocation contribution is therefore the reduction from priced weight perturbations and transformation terms to coefficients such as c l c_{l} , not the claim that continuous KKT allocation is new.

blocks.en:
Tables 2 and 3 show a consistent pattern for transformation and granularity choices, where the selected configuration changes how the candidate perturbation induces layer-output error.
In transformation selection, the price-guided selector gives the best PPL and the best average task score on both models.
On Llama-3.2-3B it improves over CALM-CKA from 8.81 to 8.58 PPL and from 58.58 to 58.96 average score.
On Llama-3.1-8B it similarly improves PPL from 6.97 to 6.86 and gives a slightly higher average score, 64.24 versus 64.18, while maintaining the comparable selection time cost of CALM-CKA.
For granularity allocation, the price-guided choice gives the best PPL on both models and the best average score on Llama-3.1-8B.
The random baselines are much less reliable in these two blocks, especially in PPL, so the price-guided rule is not just avoiding a weak fixed default.

blocks.en: Here we describe the baselines used in the price-guided configuration selection experiments in Sec. 4.2 and Appx. C .

blocks.en: • HIGGS [ 29 ] : HIGGS is a mixed-precision method based on Linearity Theorem. It links per-layer ℓ 2 \ell_{2} reconstruction error to perplexity increase through layerwise linear coefficients, and uses the resulting linearized objective to choose nonuniform layer bitwidths under the same compression budget. • AMQ [ 19 ] : AMQ is a search-based mixed-precision weight-only quantization baseline. It formulates layerwise bit allocation as a discrete multi objective search over bitwidth assignments under a memory budget, then makes the search practical with an iterative NSGA-II method before deploying the selected allocation with the final quantization backend. It is worth noting that search-based methods like AMQ can cost much more time than our price-guided selector.
blocks.zh: • HIGGS[29]: HIGGS是一种基于线性定理的混合精度方法. 它将每层l 2\ell\\2}重建错误与通过层层线性系数增加的复杂度联系起来,并利用由此产生的线性化目标在相同的压缩预算下选择非统一层位宽. • AMQ [19]: AMQ是一个基于搜索的混合精度重量只量化的基准. 它在内存预算下将分层比特分配设定为离散的多目标搜索,然后用迭代NSGA-II方法使搜索实用,然后用最后的量化后端部署选定的分配. 值得注意的是,像AMQ这样的基于搜索的方法比我们的价格指导选择器要花费更多的时间.

blocks.en:
Transformation selection fixes W4 quantization with group size 128 128 and chooses among the identity transform, AWQ-style scaling, SmoothQuant-style scaling, Hadamard rotation, and normalized diagonal whitening.
The SmoothQuant-style scale uses α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 ; Hadamard rotations use deterministic layerwise Rademacher signs with seed 0 0 when the input dimension is a power of two.
The CALM-CKA baseline chooses the candidate with maximum linear CKA, and random baselines use seeds 0 0 , 1 1 , and 2 2 .
Granularity selection fixes W4, no transformation, uniform integer quantization, and min–max clipping, and chooses among per-tensor, per-channel, group sizes 32 32 , 64 64 , and 128 128 , and 64 × 64 64\times 64 block-wise quantization.
Granularity costs include FP32 scale metadata, reported as effective weight bits; ties within 1 % 1\% of the best price are broken by lower effective bit cost and then by the latency proxy.
Transformation and granularity checkpoints are saved as dense fake-quant Hugging Face checkpoints rather than packed deployment artifacts.

变形检查站和颗粒式检查站被保存为密集的假冒式Hugging Face检查站,而不是包装的部署文物。
